oracles.rationale: image::codecs::tiff::TiffEncoder is the real third-party writer used for both derived real-world IFDs of the committed fixture (see ../🧪️oracle/🦀️component.rs's fixture_derivation module) and as an independent cross-check reader for IFD 0. Its public surface is a single-IFD raster codec only (confirmed by reading the vendored crate source), so the multi-IFD/tag-level mutation surface this subset declares (InsertIfd, RemoveIfd, SetTag, RemoveTag, SetByteOrder, SetSnapshot) is served by this module's own independent hand-rolled IFD-chain reader/writer — the same shape the obj/tobj entry below uses (a reference package that only reads or only writes half the surface, with the oracle module supplying the other half honestly rather than silently reusing the subject's own codec).

productionDebt.plan: The `image` crate is production-reachable TODAY from two places: the 🎞️animate plugin's video engine and 🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🗺️surface's tiled-map. Discovered by the oracle-purity gate the moment `image` was registered — the gate did its job. Phase 7 target: both call sites want raster decode/encode that ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio already implements, so routing them through decode_bmp / decode_tiff / decode_jpg retires the dependency and this record with it.
